newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's LPMO buys 10,161 tonnes of frozen beef.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's LPMO buys 10,161 tonnes of frozen beef.

text.p: South Korea's Livestock Products Marketing Organisation (LPMO) bought 10,161 tonnes of frozen beef and passed on tender for 699 tonnes due to high prices, traders said on Friday.
One trader said the tender for the passed amount of 699 tonnes will be invited again on October 22.
The LPMO had originally invited tenders for 10,860 tonnes of beef a week ago.
He said details of origin and prices would be available on Monday.
Arrivals were set for Seoul, Pusan, Daegu and Naju. Shipment of 2,481 tonnes had initially been slated for November 10, while 4,703 tonnes was set for November 20 and 3,676 tonnes for November 30.
